name: Jeuel
overview: Jeuel was a male member of the tribe of Judah, identified specifically as a descendant of Zerah. His mention in Scripture is concise, highlighting his genealogical position within the tribe. There are no additional notes or details about his life or role beyond his lineage.
namesAndTitles: The name Jeuel means 'G-d [El] has preserved,' reflecting a theologically rich meaning rooted in Hebrew. This proper name is not indicated as being given directly by God but carries a significant reminder of divine preservation.
familyAndRelationships: Jeuel is explicitly recorded as a descendant of Zerah. Scripture does not provide further family relationships for him beyond this connection to Zerah within the tribe of Judah.
scriptureSignificance: Jeuel's significance lies primarily in his genealogical placement within the tribe of Judah as a descendant of Zerah. This lineage situates him within the broader biblical narrative of the tribes of Israel, emphasizing the continuity of God's covenant people. While not elaborated upon, his inclusion in the genealogical records underscores the importance of preserving the heritage of God's chosen tribe.
